app.name: TraceLight
app.tagline: Trace any picture onto paper with your camera.

home.traceYourPhotoHint: Pick a picture, turn it into clean lines, trace it.
home.howItWorksBody:
1. Put your phone on a glass or a stack of books, about 25–40 cm above the paper.
2. Pick a picture. Pinch to resize, drag to move, twist to rotate.
3. Lock the picture, lower the opacity, and trace what you see on the screen.

sketch.title: Make it traceable
sketch.imageUnreadable: This picture could not be opened. Try another one.

workspace.lockedHint: Picture is locked. Tap the lock to move it again.
workspace.flashUnavailable: This device has no flashlight the app can use.
workspace.gestureHint: Pinch to resize · drag to move · twist to rotate

timelapse.failed: Recording could not start on this device.
timelapse.tooShort: Recording was too short — draw a little longer.
timelapse.title: Your time-lapse

camera.permissionBody: TraceLight shows your paper through the rear camera so you can trace the picture on it. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
camera.permissionBlockedBody: Camera access is turned off for TraceLight. Open Settings, allow the camera, then come back here.
camera.webPermissionBody: Allow the camera when your browser asks. If you blocked it, tap the lock icon next to the web address and allow the camera.
camera.noCameraBody: This device does not report a camera that TraceLight can use.
camera.errorBody: Another app may be using the camera. Close it and try again.

lines.home_welcome_1: Hello! I'm Lumi, TraceLight's painter spirit.
lines.home_welcome_2: We'll trace line by line together, and step by step learn to colour with real life and depth.
lines.home_welcome_3: Start with the colouring lesson right below. Finish your first lesson and the games will open!
lines.workspace_intro_1: Rest your phone on a glass or a stack of books, about thirty centimetres above the paper.
lines.workspace_intro_2: Use two fingers to zoom, shrink or rotate the picture until it fits your paper.
lines.workspace_intro_3: Happy with it? Tap the lock so the picture stays still and can't be moved by accident.
lines.workspace_intro_4: Slide the opacity bar until you can see both the picture and your pencil lines. Let's begin!
lines.sketch_intro_1: I've turned your photo into lines.
lines.sketch_intro_2: Slide Detail to add or remove lines. Fewer lines are easier to trace, more lines look closer to the photo.
lines.lesson_light_topleft: See the sun icon: light comes from the top left, so the shadows fall on the lower right.
lines.lesson_apple_outline: Let's draw a red apple. First, trace the outline of the apple, the stem and the leaf very lightly with a pencil.
lines.lesson_apple_base: Now one layer of base colour: red for the apple, dark green for the leaf, brown for the stem. Keep it light and even.
lines.lesson_apple_shadow: On the right, away from the light, is the shadow. Go over it with crimson so the apple looks round.
lines.lesson_apple_highlight: Last, the highlight at the top left. Leave the paper white, or add white pencil, to make the apple shine.
lines.lesson_apple_done: Wonderful! Your apple looks real. Light, shadow and highlight are what give it depth!
lines.lesson_fox_outline: Today we draw a fox cub. Trace the outline first, including the ears, the eyes and the tip of the tail.
lines.lesson_fox_base: Orange for the body and tail, cream for the chest, cheeks and tail tip. Use tan inside the ears.
lines.lesson_fox_shadow: Shadows sit under the chin, behind the legs and under the tail. Add burnt orange there.
lines.lesson_fox_highlight: Leave white paper on top of the head and the back. A white dot in each eye makes the fox sparkle.
lines.lesson_fox_done: Your fox looks so alive! You now know how darker colours build form.
lines.lesson_cupcake_outline: Let's draw a cupcake. Trace the swirl of frosting, the cherry and the folds of the paper cup.
lines.lesson_cupcake_base: Pink frosting, a red cherry, a turquoise paper cup and a tan cake.
lines.lesson_cupcake_shadow: On every swirl the lower right is darker. Use magenta there, and press harder on the right-hand folds of the cup.
lines.lesson_cupcake_highlight: Add highlights on the cherry and along the top of each swirl. That's the secret to soft, glossy frosting.
lines.lesson_cupcake_done: Looks delicious! You just coloured a cupcake with real depth.
lines.draw_intro_1: This is your digital drawing board. Pick a colour, draw with your finger or a stylus, and tap undo if you slip.
lines.academy_intro_1: Welcome to the Academy! The path goes from basic shapes to animals, landscapes, portraits and finally the old masters.
lines.academy_intro_2: Every lesson has four steps: outline, base colours, shadows and highlights. Draw on real paper with the camera, or right on the screen.
lines.tour_welcome: Welcome to the drawing board! Let me show you each tool.
lines.tour_pick_red: Tap the colour wheel, then choose red.
lines.tour_draw_line: Great! Now draw a straight line on the paper.
lines.tour_size: Wonderful! Drag this slider to make the brush bigger.
lines.tour_eraser: Now pick the eraser and rub out a bit of your line.
lines.tour_undo: Erased too much? Tap undo at the top to bring it back.
lines.tour_done: You know the drawing board now! Visit the Academy to learn from basic shapes to master paintings.
lines.lesson_sphere_outline: First lesson: the sphere. Trace a smooth circle, and one horizontal line for the table.
lines.lesson_sphere_base: Colour the whole ball light grey, lightly and evenly.
lines.lesson_sphere_shadow: The lower right of the ball is darker. Use grey there, then add the cast shadow on the table.
lines.lesson_sphere_highlight: Leave a white spot at the top left. One small highlight makes the ball look round!
lines.lesson_sphere_done: You just learned the biggest secret in painting: light, shadow and cast shadow!
lines.lesson_cube_outline: A cube shows three faces. Keep the edges straight, and parallel edges parallel.
lines.lesson_cube_base: Colour the top and the left face light tan.
lines.lesson_cube_shadow: Each face gets a different amount of light. The right face is furthest from the light: use brown.
lines.lesson_cube_highlight: Add a light line along the top left edge, where the light hits first.
lines.lesson_cube_done: Three faces, three values: you drew a cube with real depth!
lines.lesson_cylinder_outline: A cylinder is an ellipse on top and two straight sides. Trace them smoothly.
lines.lesson_cylinder_base: Colour the whole mug light sky blue.
lines.lesson_cylinder_shadow: On a cylinder the shadow runs down the right side. Add a band of turquoise along the right edge.
lines.lesson_cylinder_highlight: A thin vertical highlight on the left makes the mug look glossy and round.
lines.lesson_cylinder_done: Sphere, cube and cylinder: you have mastered the three basic forms behind every drawing!
lines.lesson_cat_outline: This tabby has lots of stripes. Trace the body first, then the eyes, ears and tail stripes.
lines.lesson_cat_base: Grey for the fur, pale pink for the ears and nose, lime green for the eyes.
lines.lesson_cat_shadow: Use dark grey for the stripes and the shadows under the chin and behind the legs. Shadows give the fur thickness.
lines.lesson_cat_highlight: Put a white dot in each eye and keep the top of the head light.
lines.lesson_cat_done: The kitten looks right at you! Eyes with a highlight always look alive.
lines.lesson_flower_vase_outline: The vase is a sphere with tulips. Trace the vase first, then the flowers and leaves.
lines.lesson_flower_vase_base: Blue for the vase, yellow for the tulips, green for the stems and leaves.
lines.lesson_flower_vase_shadow: The right side of the vase is darker: use navy blue. Add deeper yellow under each petal.
lines.lesson_flower_vase_highlight: Glazed pottery shines: leave a clear white highlight at the top left.
lines.lesson_flower_vase_done: A lovely still life! You combined a sphere with natural shapes.
lines.lesson_vintage_car_outline: Vintage cars are full of curves. Trace the body, then the wheels, windows and bumpers.
lines.lesson_vintage_car_base: Mint green for the body, light grey for bumpers and rims, black for the tyres.
lines.lesson_vintage_car_shadow: Under the body and inside the wheel arches it gets dark. Use a deeper mint there to give the car volume.
lines.lesson_vintage_car_highlight: Polished metal reflects strongly. Add long white streaks on the bumpers and the roof.
lines.lesson_vintage_car_done: Your vintage car shines like new! Machines need care, and you did it.
lines.lesson_mountain_lake_outline: A landscape has layers: the far mountain, the hill in the middle, the lake in front. Trace from far to near.
lines.lesson_mountain_lake_base: Grey mountain, green hill, sky blue lake, dark green pine trees.
lines.lesson_mountain_lake_shadow: The right slopes are darker. Far things are lighter, near things are stronger.
lines.lesson_mountain_lake_highlight: Add white snow on the peak and a few light streaks on the water.
lines.lesson_mountain_lake_done: A landscape with depth! Light far away, strong up close: real atmospheric perspective.
lines.lesson_portrait_girl_outline: Portraits need good proportions: the eyes sit halfway down the head. Trace the face, the hair, then the shoulders.
lines.lesson_portrait_girl_base: Skin tone for the face and neck, black for the hair, teal for the sweater.
lines.lesson_portrait_girl_shadow: Facial shadows sit under the fringe, under the chin and on one side of the neck. Use tan, very gently.
lines.lesson_portrait_girl_highlight: Add light on the hair and a tiny dot in each eye. Light on hair makes it look silky.
lines.lesson_portrait_girl_done: Your first portrait! Drawing people is hard, so be proud.
lines.lesson_scooter_outline: A scooter has soft curves. Trace the body, seat and handlebar, then two round wheels.
lines.lesson_scooter_base: Red for the body, cream for the seat, grey for the wheels and handlebar.
lines.lesson_scooter_shadow: The lower body is darker: use crimson. Add black inside the wheels.
lines.lesson_scooter_highlight: The paint is glossy: add a long white streak following the curve of the body.
lines.lesson_scooter_done: Your classic scooter is ready to ride! You drew a machine with real shine.
lines.lesson_starry_night_outline: This lesson follows The Starry Night by Vincent van Gogh. Trace the swirls in the sky, the cypress and the village.
lines.lesson_starry_night_base: Blue sky, yellow moon and stars, dark green cypress.
lines.lesson_starry_night_shadow: Van Gogh used dark blue swirling strokes to create movement. Follow the swirls, don't colour flat.
lines.lesson_starry_night_highlight: Add lemon yellow rings around each star and the moon, as if they twinkle.
lines.lesson_starry_night_done: You learned how Van Gogh painted a moving sky. Every brush stroke has a direction!
lines.lesson_pearl_earring_outline: This lesson follows Girl with a Pearl Earring by Johannes Vermeer. Trace the turned face, the turban and the earring.
lines.lesson_pearl_earring_base: Skin tone for the face, blue and yellow for the turban, dark brown for the background.
lines.lesson_pearl_earring_shadow: Light comes from the left, so the right half of the face falls into shadow. Use tan, very softly.
lines.lesson_pearl_earring_highlight: The secret of the painting is the light on the pearl, the lips and the eyes. Just a few small white dots.
lines.lesson_pearl_earring_done: A masterpiece! You learned how Vermeer used light to tell a story.
lines.exam_hall_intro_1: Welcome to the exam room! No tracing lines here, you draw with your own eyes.
lines.exam_hall_intro_2: Start with a 15-minute quiz to warm up, then try the period, midterm and final exams.
lines.exam_start_sketch: Look closely at the model, sketch a light frame first, then draw the main lines. You can do it!
lines.exam_start_draw_color: Draw the shape with the right proportions first, then colour it like the model. Watch the clock.
lines.exam_start_color_shade: Colour neatly inside the lines, darker in the shadows, lighter in the light. Let's go!
lines.exam_time_5min: Only five minutes left. Finish the main parts first.
lines.exam_time_1min: One minute left! Check your drawing and hand it in.
lines.hint_proportion_wide: Your shape is a bit wider than the model. Try drawing it a little taller.
lines.hint_proportion_tall: Your shape is a bit taller than the model. Try making it a little wider.
lines.hint_color_dark: This colour is a bit darker than the model. Try a lighter one.
lines.hint_color_light: This colour is a bit lighter than the model. Try a deeper one.
lines.hint_color_warm: The model uses warmer colours. Lean a little towards orange or red.
lines.hint_color_hue: This colour doesn't quite match the model. Look again and pick a closer one.
lines.praise_4: That colour works so well, great job!
lines.result_excellent: Excellent! This one deserves a place on the wall.
lines.result_good: Great work! Read the notes to score even higher next time.
lines.result_average: You passed! A little more practice and your mark will climb.
lines.result_fail: Not quite this time, and that's okay. Read my notes and try again.
lines.drill_intro: Follow the dotted line with a steady hand. Finish all three shapes to earn an energy brush.
lines.drill_pass: Nice and steady! On to the next shape.
lines.drill_retry: Almost! Go slower and stay close to the dots.
lines.energy_empty: You're out of energy brushes. Practise strokes to earn one, or wait for one to come back.
lines.shop_intro_1: This is the mystery box! Each box holds a special brush or an outfit for me.
lines.shop_intro_2: Coins come from doing well in exams and drawing every day. The odds are shown below.
lines.gacha_win_brush: Wow, a new brush! Pick it in the toolbar when you draw.
lines.gacha_win_outfit: A new outfit for me! Thank you so much.
lines.gacha_dupe: You already have this one, so here are some coins back.
lines.leaderboard_intro_1: This is the leaderboard of young artists this week and this month.
lines.leaderboard_intro_2: Only your nickname and chosen animal are shown. Please don't use your real name.
lines.rank_up: Congratulations! You've reached a new title!
lines.quests_intro_1: Every day there are three small quests. Finish one for coins, finish all three to open a reward chest!
lines.quests_intro_2: And here is your badge collection. Try to unlock them all!
lines.quest_done: Quest complete! Let's collect the reward.
lines.badge_unlocked: You just unlocked a new badge. Amazing!
lines.demo_intro_outline: Watch me do it first! I follow the outline lightly, one section at a time, from top to bottom.
lines.demo_intro_base: Now watch me lay the base colour. Move the pencil back and forth evenly, big areas first.
lines.demo_intro_shadow: Now the shadows. Where the light can't reach, press a little harder and follow the shape.
lines.demo_intro_highlight: Last come the highlights. Just a few light touches where the light hits.
lines.demo_your_turn: Done! Now it's your turn. Follow the same order I just used.
lines.step_ready: Wonderful, this step is nearly done! Tap the arrow for the next step.
lines.lesson_strawberry_outline: Today we draw a ripe strawberry. Lightly trace the berry, the leafy crown and the little seeds.
lines.lesson_strawberry_base: Base colours: red for the berry, dark green for the leaves, and a dot of yellow on each seed.
lines.lesson_strawberry_shadow: The right side and the bottom are in shadow. Layer deep red there so the berry looks round.
lines.lesson_strawberry_highlight: Add a few white highlights at the top left and the berry will look juicy and fresh.
lines.lesson_strawberry_done: Yummy! Your strawberry looks ripe and round.
lines.lesson_watermelon_outline: Let us draw a cool slice of watermelon. Trace the slice, the rind and the black seeds.
lines.lesson_watermelon_base: Red for the flesh, leave the white band of rind, and green for the skin.
lines.lesson_watermelon_shadow: The right edge is away from the light. Add deep red along it so the slice has thickness.
lines.lesson_watermelon_highlight: Finally a few bright spots on the flesh make it look juicy.
lines.lesson_watermelon_done: Great! Your watermelon looks so refreshing!
lines.lesson_ice_cream_outline: Let us draw a two-scoop ice cream cone. Trace the scoops and the little squares on the cone.
lines.lesson_ice_cream_base: Light pink for the top scoop, mint for the lower one, and yellow for the crunchy cone.
lines.lesson_ice_cream_shadow: The lower right of each scoop is in shadow. Add pink, lime and orange there.
lines.lesson_ice_cream_highlight: A white highlight on top of the scoop makes it look cold and creamy.
lines.lesson_ladybug_outline: Let us draw a ladybug. Trace the round body, the head, the antennae and the spots.
lines.lesson_ladybug_base: Bright red for the wings, black for the head, legs and spots.
lines.lesson_ladybug_shadow: The lower right of the wings is in shadow. Layer deep red there so the back looks domed.
lines.lesson_ladybug_highlight: A white highlight on the back makes the ladybug shine like a jewel.
lines.lesson_ladybug_done: Your ladybug is shiny and adorable!
lines.lesson_goldfish_outline: Today we draw a goldfish. Trace its body, big eye and flowing fan tail.
lines.lesson_goldfish_base: Orange for the body, light tan for the fins and tail.
lines.lesson_goldfish_shadow: The belly and lower right are in shadow. Add rust and brown so the fish looks round.
lines.lesson_goldfish_highlight: White sparkles in the eye and on the back make it shimmer.
lines.lesson_mushroom_outline: Let us draw two toadstools. Trace the caps, the stems and the white spots.
lines.lesson_mushroom_base: Red for the caps, leave the spots white, cream for the stems.
lines.lesson_mushroom_shadow: Under the caps and on the right of the stems is shadow. Add deep red and tan there.
lines.lesson_mushroom_highlight: A white highlight on top of each cap makes it glossy.
lines.lesson_mushroom_done: Your mushrooms look like they came from a fairy tale!
lines.lesson_owl_outline: Let us draw an owl on a branch. Trace its body, big round eyes, wings and the branch.
lines.lesson_owl_base: Brown for the back and wings, cream for the belly, light tan for the eye rims and beak.
lines.lesson_owl_shadow: The right side and under the wings are in shadow. Add dark brown there.
lines.lesson_owl_highlight: White sparkles in the eyes make the owl look wise and alert.
lines.lesson_owl_done: Your owl has such lovely round eyes!
lines.lesson_panda_outline: Today we draw a baby panda with bamboo. Trace the round body, ears, eye patches and bamboo.
lines.lesson_panda_base: Black for the ears, eye patches, arms and legs. Leave the body white, green for the bamboo.
lines.lesson_panda_shadow: The right side is in shadow. Add a light grey on the white fur so the panda looks chubby.
lines.lesson_panda_highlight: Add white sparkles in the eyes and on the bamboo joints.
lines.lesson_sunflower_outline: Let us draw a sunflower. Trace each petal around the round centre, the stem and two leaves.
lines.lesson_sunflower_base: Bright yellow petals, brown centre, green stem and leaves.
lines.lesson_sunflower_shadow: The base of each petal and the lower half of each leaf are in shadow. Add orange and dark green.
lines.lesson_sunflower_highlight: Dot a few highlights on the centre and the petal tips.
lines.lesson_sunflower_done: Your sunflower is as bright as the sun!
lines.lesson_teapot_outline: Let us draw a porcelain teapot. Trace the round body, lid, curved spout, handle and pattern band.
lines.lesson_teapot_base: Pale sky blue for the body, leave the pattern band white.
lines.lesson_teapot_shadow: It is round, so the right side and bottom are in shadow. Add blue softly.
lines.lesson_teapot_highlight: Porcelain is shiny: add a long white highlight on the body and lid.
lines.lesson_teapot_done: Your teapot shines like real porcelain!
lines.lesson_unicorn_outline: Today we draw a rainbow unicorn. Trace the body, mane, tail and twisted horn.
lines.lesson_unicorn_base: Leave the body white, colour the mane and tail light pink, mint and lilac, the horn yellow.
lines.lesson_unicorn_shadow: Under the belly and the back legs is shadow. Add very light grey, and purple in the mane.
lines.lesson_unicorn_highlight: Add sparkles on the horn and in the eye.
lines.lesson_balloon_outline: Let us draw a striped hot air balloon. Trace the balloon, the stripes, the ropes and the basket.
lines.lesson_balloon_base: Alternate red, yellow and sky blue stripes, light tan for the basket.
lines.lesson_balloon_shadow: The balloon is round, so the right stripes are darker. Add crimson, deep yellow and blue on the right.
lines.lesson_balloon_highlight: A curved highlight on the left makes it look full of air.
lines.lesson_balloon_done: Your balloon is ready to fly!
lines.lesson_lighthouse_outline: Let us draw a lighthouse on a rock. Trace the tower, stripes, lamp room and rocks.
lines.lesson_lighthouse_base: Red and white stripes for the tower, yellow for the lamp room, grey for the rocks.
lines.lesson_lighthouse_shadow: The tower is a cylinder, so the right side is darker. Add crimson and dark grey along it.
lines.lesson_lighthouse_highlight: The lamp glows: add white at the lamp room and on the left edge of the tower.
lines.lesson_lighthouse_done: Your lighthouse is ready to guide the ships!
lines.lesson_sailboat_outline: Let us draw a sailboat on the waves. Trace the hull, sail, flag and waves.
lines.lesson_sailboat_base: Brown for the wooden hull, leave the sail white, red flag, sky blue waves.
lines.lesson_sailboat_shadow: The right of the sail and hull is in shadow. Add light grey, dark brown, and deep blue on the waves.
lines.lesson_sailboat_highlight: White on the wave crests makes the water sparkle.
lines.lesson_dragon_outline: Advanced lesson: a baby dragon. Trace its round body, little wings, horns, back spikes and tail.
lines.lesson_dragon_base: Lime for the body, cream for the belly, dark green for the spikes and wings.
lines.lesson_dragon_shadow: The right side, the belly and under the wings are in shadow. Add green and tan there.
lines.lesson_dragon_highlight: Add highlights in the eyes and on top of the head.
lines.lesson_dragon_done: Your baby dragon is brave and cute!
lines.lesson_castle_outline: Advanced lesson: a fairy-tale castle. Trace the walls, three towers, cone roofs, windows and flags.
lines.lesson_castle_base: Light pink walls, purple tower roofs, lime flags.
lines.lesson_castle_shadow: The towers are round, so their right sides are darker. Add pink on the walls and deep purple on the roofs.
lines.lesson_castle_highlight: Highlights on the roofs and windows make the castle sparkle.
lines.lesson_castle_done: Your castle looks straight out of a fairy tale!
lines.lesson_portrait_boy_outline: Portrait lesson: a boy in a red cap. Trace the face, hair, cap, ears and collar.
lines.lesson_portrait_boy_base: Skin colour for the face and ears, red cap, sky blue shirt, black hair.
lines.lesson_portrait_boy_shadow: Under the cap, under the chin and on the right of the face is shadow. Add tan, crimson and deep blue.
lines.lesson_portrait_boy_highlight: Highlights in the eyes, on the cheeks and on the cap make the face lively.
lines.lesson_portrait_boy_done: Your portrait has real life, the boy is smiling happily!
lines.games_locked: Let's finish one colouring lesson first! Then the exam room and the games will open.
lines.games_unlocked: Hooray! You unlocked the exam room, quests and the shop!
lines.level_locked: This one is a bit harder. Finish two lessons of the level before to unlock it!
lines.lesson_complete_3: Excellent! Three stars! You colour like a real artist.
lines.lesson_complete_2: Very good! Two stars. Colour a little more fully next time for three.
lines.lesson_complete_1: You finished the lesson! Try again to earn more stars.
lines.path_intro_1: This is your colouring path. Every lesson has three stars to win.
lines.path_intro_2: Finish two basic lessons to open the intermediate ones, then the advanced. You can do it!
lines.gallery_intro: This is your gallery, where the drawings you finished are kept.
lines.lesson_toddler_outline: First portrait: a chubby toddler. Lightly trace the round face, curly hair, ears and collar.
lines.lesson_toddler_base: Skin colour for the face and ears, yellow for the shirt, tan for the curly hair.
lines.lesson_toddler_shadow: The right of the face, under the chin and under the hair are in shadow. Use a deeper skin tone for chubby cheeks.
lines.lesson_toddler_highlight: Sparkles in the eyes, a little pink on the cheeks, highlights on the hair.
lines.lesson_toddler_done: Your toddler looks so real and adorable!
lines.lesson_schoolgirl_outline: Let us draw a schoolgirl. Trace the face, ponytail, ribbon, collar and red scarf.
lines.lesson_schoolgirl_base: Skin colour for the face, black hair, red ribbon and scarf, leave the shirt white.
lines.lesson_schoolgirl_shadow: Light comes from the left, so the right cheek, the neck and the shirt folds are in shadow. Add deeper skin, crimson and light grey.
lines.lesson_schoolgirl_highlight: Sparkles in the eyes and a shine on the hair make her look lively.
lines.lesson_young_woman_outline: Portrait: a young woman in an ao dai. Gently trace the face, long hair, high collar and shoulders.
lines.lesson_young_woman_base: Skin colour for the face and neck, black for the hair, light turquoise for the ao dai.
lines.lesson_young_woman_shadow: The right of the face, under the chin and the folds of the dress are in shadow. Add deeper skin and turquoise.
lines.lesson_young_woman_highlight: Highlights in the eyes, on the lips and a few shines on the silky hair.
lines.lesson_young_woman_done: Your portrait is graceful and lifelike!
lines.lesson_man_glasses_outline: Adult portrait: a man with glasses and a beard. Trace the face, round glasses, hair, beard and collar.
lines.lesson_man_glasses_base: Skin colour for the face, green for the shirt, dark brown for the hair and beard.
lines.lesson_man_glasses_shadow: Under the chin, the right of the face and inside the collar are in shadow. Add tan and dark green.
lines.lesson_man_glasses_highlight: Glasses reflect light: add a small white streak on the lenses and in the eyes.
lines.lesson_grandma_outline: Elderly portrait: a kind grandmother. Trace the face, hair bun, wrinkles around the eyes and collar. Keep the wrinkles light.
lines.lesson_grandma_base: Skin colour for the face, silver grey for the hair, purple for the blouse.
lines.lesson_grandma_shadow: The wrinkles, under the chin and the right of the face are in shadow. Follow the wrinkles lightly with rust.
lines.lesson_grandma_highlight: Sparkles in the eyes and on the silver hair make her look warm.
lines.lesson_grandma_done: Your grandmother is smiling so kindly!
lines.lesson_grandpa_outline: Portrait: a cheerful grandfather. Trace the face, white hair, moustache, wrinkles and cardigan.
lines.lesson_grandpa_base: Skin colour for the face, leave the hair and moustache white, tan for the cardigan.
lines.lesson_grandpa_shadow: The hollow cheeks, under the moustache, the right of the face and the folds are in shadow. Add tan, grey and brown.
lines.lesson_grandpa_highlight: Sparkles in the eyes and on the forehead make him look kind.
lines.lesson_grandpa_done: Your grandfather is beaming with life!
lines.lesson_rice_terraces_outline: Landscape: rice terraces. Trace the far mountains, the clouds and each curving terrace.
lines.lesson_rice_terraces_base: Alternate lime and dark green for the terraces, blue for the mountains, sky blue for the sky.
lines.lesson_rice_terraces_shadow: The lower edge of each terrace and the right slopes are in shadow. Use deeper green for layered steps.
lines.lesson_rice_terraces_highlight: Leave the clouds white and add sunny streaks on the terrace edges.
lines.lesson_rice_terraces_done: Your rice terraces look like a postcard!
lines.lesson_beach_sunset_outline: Landscape: a beach at sunset. Trace the sun, the horizon, the palm tree, the sand and the waves.
lines.lesson_beach_sunset_base: Orange-yellow sun, blue sea, yellow sand, green palm leaves.
lines.lesson_beach_sunset_shadow: The sun is behind, so the water near the shore and the trunk are darker. Add tan for wet sand and navy for the sea.
lines.lesson_beach_sunset_highlight: White on the wave tops and sparkles of sunlight on the water.
lines.lesson_beach_sunset_done: Your sunset is warm and peaceful!
lines.lesson_village_house_outline: Landscape: a little country house. Trace the tiled roof, walls, windows, big tree and fence.
lines.lesson_village_house_base: Red roof, tan walls, lime for the tree and grass, brown for the trunk.
lines.lesson_village_house_shadow: The right wall, under the eaves and the lower half of the tree are in shadow. Add crimson, deeper tan and green.
lines.lesson_village_house_highlight: Shine on the roof tiles and a few bright dots on the leaves.
lines.lesson_city_street_outline: Advanced landscape: an old street. Trace the houses, balconies, windows, lamp post and road in perspective.
lines.lesson_city_street_base: Give each house its colour: red, blue, yellow; grey road, green plant pots.
lines.lesson_city_street_shadow: Under the balconies and on the shaded walls is shadow. Add crimson, deep blue and dark grey.
lines.lesson_city_street_highlight: Highlights on the window glass and the lamp post.
lines.lesson_city_street_done: Your street is bright and lively!
lines.lesson_karst_bay_outline: Advanced landscape: a bay with limestone islands. Trace the islands, the water and the wooden boat.
lines.lesson_karst_bay_base: Turquoise water, dark green trees on the islands, grey cliffs, brown boat.
lines.lesson_karst_bay_shadow: The right cliffs and the reflections are in shadow. Add deep turquoise and dark grey.
lines.lesson_karst_bay_highlight: Add bright streaks on the water so the bay sparkles.
lines.lesson_karst_bay_done: Your bay is majestic and dreamy!

exam.hallHint: 15-minute tests, one-period tests, mid-term and end-of-term exams. No tracing layer here: look at the model and draw it yourself.

task.sketch: Quick sketch: look at the model and draw its shape in lines.
task.drawColor: Finished drawing: draw the model, then colour it.
task.colorShade: Colouring and shading: the outline is printed on the exam paper.

exam.rules: Time: {minutes} minutes. No tracing layer. The paper is collected automatically when time is up.
exam.leaveBody: Your work will not be graded.
exam.timeUp: Time's up! Your paper was handed in automatically.
exam.creativityNote: Creativity is an automatic estimate (colour variety, extra details, stroke variety), for guidance only.

proportion.high: Shape and proportions are very close to the model.
proportion.mid: The shape is close but proportions are off. Compare height and width of the model before drawing.
proportion.low: The shape differs a lot. Block in the big shapes first, details later.

neatness.high: Very neat colouring inside the lines.
neatness.mid: Some colour went over the lines.
neatness.low: A lot of colour went outside. Slow down near the outline.

color.high: Colours and light/shadow are very close to the model.
color.mid: Colours are mostly right, but light and shadow are not clear yet.
color.low: Colours differ from the model or the subject isn't coloured enough. Look closely at each area.

creativity.high: Lots of personal touches and interesting details.
creativity.mid: A bit of creativity. Try adding a background or details of your own.
creativity.low: Be brave: add details, a background or colours of your own.

game.energyRules: Each exam needs at least 1 brush. Quitting or not passing costs 1 brush. A brush comes back every 30 minutes, or practise basic strokes to earn one right away. Lessons and free drawing are always free.
game.examCost: Note: quitting or not passing costs 1 energy brush.
game.streakRules: Draw at least one stroke a day (lesson, free drawing or exam) to keep your streak. Day 3 gives 10 coins, every 7 days gives 30 coins.
game.streakNotYet: Not yet today: draw one stroke to keep it!
